export declare const SKILLS_MANAGE_PERMISSION = "skills:manage";

export declare const SKILLS_PERMISSIONS: readonly ["skills:read", "skills:manage"];

export declare const SKILLS_PROVIDER_ID = "system.skills";

export declare const SKILLS_READ_PERMISSION = "skills:read";

export declare const SKILL_BODY_READ_MAX_REFS = 20;

export declare const SKILL_CATALOG_ENTRY_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const SKILL_EXCERPT_CHARS = 200;

export declare const SKILL_INSTALL_PREVIEW_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const SKILL_READ_REFUSALS: readonly ["plugin_disabled", "publisher_revoked", "resource_invalid", "requires_unmet", "connection_missing", "native_only", "not_applicable", "not_current", "off", "not_named"];

export declare const SKILL_REF_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const SKILL_RESOURCE_READ_MAX_BYTES: number;

export declare const SKILL_SCOPES: readonly ["project", "home"];

export declare const SKILL_SETTINGS_LOCKED_REASONS: readonly ["plugin_disabled", "publisher_revoked", "resource_invalid"];

export declare const SKILL_STATES: readonly ["off", "auto", "manual"];

export declare const SKILL_UNAVAILABLE_REASONS: readonly ["plugin_disabled", "publisher_revoked", "resource_invalid", "requires_unmet", "connection_missing", "native_only", "not_applicable"];

export type SkillAvailability = {
    available: true;
} | {
    available: false;
    reason: SkillUnavailableReason;
    detail?: string;
};

export interface SkillBodyReadRequest {
    refs: SkillRef[];
}

export type SkillBodyReadResult = {
    ref: SkillRef;
    ok: true;
    name: string;
    body: string;
} | {
    ref: SkillRef;
    ok: false;
    reason: SkillReadRefusal;
    detail?: string;
};

export interface SkillCatalogEntry {
    ref: SkillRef;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    when_to_use?: string;
    when_not_to_use?: string;
    applies_to: SkillAppliesTo;
    user_invocable: boolean;
    argument_hint?: string;
    tools: string[];
    resources: SkillResourceSummary[];
    connector_categories: string[];
    runs_scripts: boolean;
    excerpt: string;
    pack: {
        plugin_id: string;
        title: string;
        version: string;
        publisher_label: string;
        trust: SkillPackTrust;
        scope: SkillScope;
    };
    state: SkillState;
    settings_revision: number;
    enabled?: {
        at: string;
        by: string;
        scope: SkillScope;
    };
    availability: SkillAvailability;
    last_used?: {
        at: string;
        caller: "assistant" | "coding" | "agent";
        run_ref?: string;
    };
}

export interface SkillCatalogListRequest {
    applies_to?: Exclude<SkillAppliesTo, "both">;
    states?: SkillState[];
}

export interface SkillImportCandidate {
    skill_id: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    file_count: number;
    bytes: number;
    importable: boolean;
    applies_to?: SkillAppliesTo;
    applies_to_from?: "file" | "suggested";
    compatibility: "portable" | "native-only";
    reason?: string;
    runs_scripts: boolean;
    change: "new" | "upgrade";
}

export interface SkillImportConfirmRequest {
    preview_id: string;
    skill_ids: string[];
    scope: SkillScope;
    applies_to?: Array<{
        skill_id: string;
        applies_to: SkillAppliesTo;
    }>;
}

export interface SkillImportConfirmResult {
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
    publisher_key_id: string;
}

export interface SkillImportPreview {
    preview_id: string;
    package: {
        plugin_id: string;
        version: string;
        installed_version: string | null;
    };
    applies_to: SkillAppliesTo;
    candidates: SkillImportCandidate[];
}

export interface SkillImportPreviewRequest {
    source: SkillImportSource;
}

export type SkillImportSource = {
    kind: "runtime";
    runtime_id: CharacterImportRuntimeId;
} | {
    kind: "project_directory";
    directory_id: string;
};

export interface SkillInstallPreview {
    skill_id: string;
    version: number;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    when_to_use?: string;
    when_not_to_use?: string;
    applies_to: SkillAppliesTo;
    user_invocable: boolean;
    argument_hint?: string;
    native_only_reason?: string;
    tools: string[];
    resources: SkillResourceSummary[];
    runs_scripts: boolean;
    connector_categories: string[];
    excerpt: string;
    change?: "added" | "body_changed" | "resources_changed" | "removed";
    state: SkillState;
}

export type SkillPackTrust = "host" | "pinned" | "home_local";

export type SkillReadRefusal = (typeof SKILL_READ_REFUSALS)[number];

export interface SkillResourceContent {
    ref: SkillRef;
    path: string;
    role: SkillResourceRole;
    media_type: string;
    bytes: number;
    sha256: string;
    encoding: "utf8" | "base64";
    content: string;
}

export interface SkillResourceReadRequest {
    ref: SkillRef;
    path: string;
}

export interface SkillResourceSummary {
    path: string;
    role: SkillResourceRole;
    bytes: number;
}

export type SkillScope = (typeof SKILL_SCOPES)[number];

export interface SkillSettingsSetRequest {
    scope: SkillScope;
    install_id: string;
    skill_id: string;
    state: SkillState;
    expected_revision: number;
}

export type SkillState = (typeof SKILL_STATES)[number];

export type SkillUnavailableReason = (typeof SKILL_UNAVAILABLE_REASONS)[number];

export declare const servicesSkillsContract: {
    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.service.skills.v1";
    readonly kind: "service";
    readonly schemaVersion: 1;
    readonly maturity: "partial";
    readonly ssot: "specs/skill-packs/contract-design.md";
};

export declare const skillCatalogActions: {
    list: ActionDefinition<SkillCatalogListRequest, {
        skills: SkillCatalogEntry[];
    }>;
    readBodies: ActionDefinition<SkillBodyReadRequest, {
        results: SkillBodyReadResult[];
    }>;
    readResource: ActionDefinition<SkillResourceReadRequest, SkillResourceContent>;
    setState: ActionDefinition<SkillSettingsSetRequest, SkillCatalogEntry>;
};

    readonly read_refused: "forbidden";
    readonly resource_undeclared: "not_found";
    readonly settings_conflict: "conflict";

    readonly scope_mismatch: "invalid";
    readonly import_source_unavailable: "not_found";
    readonly import_preview_unknown: "not_found";
    readonly import_skill_unknown: "invalid";
    readonly import_applies_to_invalid: "invalid";
}>;

export declare const skillImportActions: {
